biggest_catch: Rates are tiny ($0.015–$0.025 per word) and tasks are first-come-first-serve with no guaranteed volume — real hourly earnings depend entirely on grabbing small tasks fast.
catches: Per-word rates are low: Post-Machine Translation $0.025/word (avg. $15–$20 per order), Copy-Edit $0.015/word (avg. $10–$15 per order), Document Translation $0.02/word (avg. $10–$100 per order).
Zero guaranteed tasks: 'Every task is first come, first serve. No more bidding or waiting for translations' — availability depends on client volume in your language pair.
Must pass Translate.com's internal exams and set language pairs before getting work; certified translators earn more (diploma upload required).
$20 minimum balance to cash out; no payout until you reach it.
Must fill in payment details AND submit tax information during account setup.
Effective hourly pay can be very low for micro-tasks (post-machine editing of short texts).

steps: Create a free account at https://www.translate.com/translators and attach your certificates, then wait for verification.
In account setup, pass Translate.com's internal exams and set your language pair(s).
Fill in your payment details and submit your tax information (both required).
Once approved, pick translation tasks from your Task Board — tasks are first come, first serve, so check regularly.
Complete translations to quality standards; sustained high quality opens the editor role.
Your earnings accumulate per word at the published rates; funds are released to your payment system once the balance exceeds $20.
timing: Receive your funds once they exceed $20 to your payment system (PayPal, Wise, Revolut, Payoneer, Paxum, or AdvCash); no payment schedule published.
